title: Wake & Win — Morning Outreach Playbook (personal)
content:
06:10 — quick brain dump before coffee
Goal for this AM sprint:
- 10 dials (aim for 4 connects)
- 8 personalized emails sent (short + value)
- 4 CRM updates/logs

Priority accounts (top-of-mind):
1) NovaRetail (AE: Maya) — Platform team, looking at Dedicated capacity in Q4. Key pain: noisy burst traffic, cost predictability. Call objective: book 30-min discovery with infra lead.
2) Zephyr Health (AE: Lucas) — research note: regulatory concerns; emphasize Private (VPC) options + KMS.
3) Luma Labs (AE: Priya) — PLG experiment stalled by latency; propose A/B on model variants + Redwood Optimize suggestions.
4) AtlasPay (AE: Jordan) — need SLA for peak-hours; mention Dedicated + canary rollouts.
5) Hummingbird Media (AE: Sasha) — wants embeddings use-case. Quick win: share 1-pager + sample cost calc.
6) Small batch of inbound trial accounts (auto-tag: inbound-trial) — quick qualification script.

Call script crib (30–60s open):
- Hook: "Hey <name>, quick one — are you the person owning inference for product X?"
- If yes: "Gotcha. We help teams cut per-token costs and stabilize latency during bursts — curious if that’s something you’re wrestling with?"
- If interest: ask two quick qualifiers: current provider + typical p95 latency requirement. Close: "Want to sync 20 mins later this week to run a cost/latency sketch for your workload?"
- If no: ask for intro or best contact, log disposition.

Email snippets (short + 1 value):
- Subject: quick note — latency during spikes
  Body: hi <name>, noticed you run batch preds for X. We helped a media customer reduce p95 by ~30% with small infra + batching tweaks. If that’s relevant, 15-min call to show before/after? — Cleo

- Subject: embeddings cost check?
  Body: hi <name>, small heads-up — embedding costs can balloon w/ naive batching. We built a simple cache suggestion that cut token spend 40% for one customer. Happy to share a sample calc?

Disposition codes (my quick mapping):
- VM — left succinct reason + ask for callback window
- NO-INT — politely not interested now (follow-up in 90d)
- MAYBE — wants more info (send 1-pager + 3-day follow-up)
- HOT — schedule meeting within 48h
- REFERRAL — ask for intro, mark AE and follow-up owner

Follow-up cadence (for inbound/maybe):
- Day 0: send value email + calendar invite placeholder (no link)
- Day 2: short nudge (2-line), include one quick stat or customer name
- Day 7: call if no reply (target VM + email)
- Day 21: final check + doc drop (one-pager)

CRM quick tasks while logging:
- Tag contact with 'wake-win-2026-10-03'
- Add short note: "first-touch: value-claim (latency/cost) — testing short-email template B"
- Set next activity (2 days) and attach script snippet id: outreach-scripts#78

Personal timeboxing (today):
- 06:30–07:30 — AM dials (sprint 45/15)
- 07:30–08:00 — send 8 personalized emails + update CRM
- 08:00–08:20 — quick AE handoffs (internal notes)
- 08:30 — team stand: report top 3 wins/blocks

Open questions / things to fix in my process:
- Template B feels weak — need an extra metric to land credibility. Try adding a short % improvement + small customer name next run.
- Need a one-pager for Private deployment checklist (ops-focused) to attach during qualification. TODO: ask Solutions Eng for 1-pager by Friday.
- Can I get a short benchmark (p95 pre/post) from product-team for Luma Labs case? ping Juno.

Micro-reflections after each 30-min sprint (log here):
- 06:30 sprint 1: 7 dials, 2 connects (NovaRetail VM was good; left callback window 2–4pm).
- 06:45 sprint 2: 8 dials, 3 connects (Luma Labs engineering was curious; sent sample chart).

Quick copy bank (for fast personalization):
- "We cut p95 by ~30% for a streaming app using KV cache + batching tweaks."
- "Canary rollouts mean you can fail back to a cheaper variant without customer impact."
- "Private option supports customer-managed KMS for regulated data."

Final quick checklist before end of AM:
- All hot leads scheduled in calendar with AE stub
- CRM next-activity set for every engaged contact
- Send internal note to AE owner for handoff (include one-pager link)
- Log experiments: which email variant used, open rate, replies

Notes to self: keep intros short, lead with customer outcome, and track which one-liner converts best. If I get 3 replies from this morning, scale template and report in stand.

-- Cleo
notes: personal scratchpad — not for external sharing; will prune and formalize templates into repo later (linked: github:repo/outreach-scripts#78)
